name: Tachibana Yuuya
source:
The son of a distinguished family that owns a large conglomerate Tachibana Zaibatsu.
Although he is the second son, he was raised by his grandfather, known as the "Monster of the Showa Era," a powerful figure behind the scenes in the political and financial world, and was instilled with a unique leadership style.
At first glance, he appears to be a violent, short-tempered tyrant, but he has a strong sense of self-confidence that comes from the belief that they are kings who should rule over the people. He believes that committing cruel acts without hesitation is the right of a king.
He looks down on Kazuki, who is weak and has an androgynous appearance, calling him "little girl" or "little deer." He is blessed with a strong physique and possesses physical strength that most people cannot match. He has a rule not to complain about the food he is given. He once invited Mizuki to go hunting when Mizuki was alive.

[Translated from [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/pigeon/]Official site[/url] and [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/PigeonBlood]Wikipedia[/url]]
